text: それは　たのしそう　だなあ！

structure.jp: たのしそう　だなあ！

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そう put on a describing word with its last い dropped says how something looks or sounds to you. たのしそう　だ = 'it sounds fun'.

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: なあ at the end shows the speaker is feeling something and saying it half to himself. たのしそう　だなあ = 'that sure sounds fun'.
